description: This file contains the PHP class 'SubscriptionPlan' which is part of the Admin Model for Catalog in the OpenCart system. It provides methods for managing subscription plans including adding, editing, copying, deleting, and retrieving subscription plan data and descriptions.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: This class manages CRUD operations and data retrieval for subscription plans within the OpenCart admin catalog model.

methods.name: addSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Adds a new subscription plan to the database and its descriptions.

methods.name: editSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Updates an existing subscription plan with new data and descriptions.

methods.name: copySubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing subscription plan and its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Deletes a subscription plan and its associated descriptions and related product subscriptions.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subscription plan and its description.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscription plans, optionally filtered and sorted.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscription plans.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a subscription plan in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a specific subscription plan.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a particular subscription plan.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions that are in a specific language.
